verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal. Terminal products can plausibly ship conversational AI agents, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only SSH/Mosh connectivity, local shell commands, VS Code connections and file management. It never mentions an AI agent that browses, searches, edits or performs git commit/pull/push through conversation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation
